class Metrics:
    number=0
    @pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True,tryfirst=True)
    def pytest_runtest_teardown(self,item,nextitem):
        yield
        self.number+=1
        if self.number==1 or self.number%100==0 or self.number==819:
            from prometheus_client import REGISTRY
            rows=[]
            for collector in list(REGISTRY._collector_to_names):
                children=getattr(collector,'_metrics',None)
                values=list(children.values()) if isinstance(children,dict) else [collector]
                locks=0
                for child in values:
                    for value in vars(child).values():
                        candidates=value if isinstance(value,(list,tuple)) else [value]
                        locks+=sum(type(entry).__module__=='prometheus_client.values' and hasattr(entry,'_lock') for entry in candidates)
                rows.append(dict(name=getattr(collector,'_name',type(collector).__name__),
                                 kind=type(collector).__name__,children=len(values),value_locks=locks))
            row=dict(number=self.number,nodeid=item.nodeid,handles=snapshot(),metrics=rows)
            with Path('C:\\AI\\ShopSquire\\.artifacts\\roadmap-execution-2026-10-20\\v7-histogram-fixed-prefix819-diagnostic\\metrics.jsonl').open('a',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                stream.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')

        assert {item.nodeid for item in items}==set(selection['original'])
